answer: Quartz locks the chain: 48 quartz prisms open each epoch, and each identity cracks a four-link chain in 25 minutes, each key hidden in the previous link's hash. Every link needs a plume: a stranger's co-signature, at most two chains each; a plume takes three epochs to earn. Ten fakes need five hands, forty links, forty plumes at once. Entry locks 65 POA, +35 per extra identity from one root: ten fakes lock 2,225 POA, a missed link burns 20. The ledger checks link order, plume age, roots: one hand, several chains, one identity. A raven carries one link at a time; no script flies forty.
